fieldValues.title: Open every repository through lenses: a set, one thing, and what links to it
fieldValues.move: srs-web gets one shell of three panes, each built once: the set being worked through, the one thing in focus, and its links grouped by meaning. A lens decides how each pane is filled and named. Derived lenses come from navigation, compositions and types with no setup; curated lenses name the links in the domain's words; switching lens keeps the selected record at one address. Today's editors become curated lenses of the same shell, and every pane gets a "tell apart by" control in which "nothing" is a first-class choice.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: The engine gaps that force client-side workarounds (a whole Composition with its sections, per-record ids in rendered output, typed neighbours, note reads), and where lens definitions live long term, which needs an RFC for a package-level presentation object.
fieldValues.falsifier: A person new to srs-web, given the spec, muSrs, srs-programme and the semanticops.com source, cannot within five minutes on each find a record, follow two of its links and get back without help; or a curated lens needs code outside the shared panes.
fieldValues.return_when: When the Focus pane is lens-driven (reading, document, writing surface) and the four-corpus walkthrough has been run with the owner.
